claims: The multi-probe same-model plan and partial scores reconstruct across a fresh process from original experiment custody without invoking the model again.
This is fixture recovery evidence; production and real-model behavior are unverified.
details: The same-model probe-suite recovery case now invokes a distinct Python interpreter, reopens the original developmental experiment store from its original custody path, reloads the run through the canonical verifier and compares the suite evaluation and per-condition correct counts. It performs no inference during child recovery.
